svg.title: American Commercial Glass project locations across the United States
svg.desc: 75 source-backed ACG project records: 73 in Florida, 1 in Louisiana, and 1 in Tennessee. White markers identify glazing projects and red markers identify supply-only material orders. The Florida inset separates projects sharing the same metro area.
svg.metadata: State boundaries simplified from the U.S. Census Bureau 2025 TIGER/Line state boundary. Markers are plotted at city level and fanned slightly when multiple projects share one city.
svg.text: CITY-LEVEL LOCATIONS / COINCIDENT PROJECTS FANNED FOR VISIBILITY
